+    def format_read2016_triple_page(self):
+        """
+        Format the READ 2016 dataset at triple-page level.
+
+        Added 2026-10 for the multi-page scaling study; the page and double_page paths above are
+        untouched. Construction: within each split the scans are taken in the order
+        preformat_read2016 enumerates them (sorted PAGE-XML names, i.e. scan order) and cut into
+        consecutive, NON-overlapping triples; a trailing remainder of one or two scans is dropped
+        (350 -> 116, 50 -> 16, 50 -> 16). These are the same source triples as the V1 manifest
+        experiments/benchmark_suite/manifests/READ_2016_triple_page_sem.json, so provenance is
+        continuous. The three 300-dpi scans are concatenated horizontally and the result is then
+        resized to self.dpi with self.resize, exactly like format_read2016_double_page. Unlike
+        DAN's written-page-number pairs, consecutive scans do not always share a height: a shorter
+        scan is padded at the BOTTOM with its own median colour (paper tone) up to the tallest
+        scan of the triple, and the padded height is recorded in "pages"[i]["pad_bottom_px"].
+        Each page label is sort_text_regions' output (unchanged function); the document label is
+        page + label_1 + PAGE + page + label_2 + PAGE + page + label_3 + PAGE under the
+        sem_token/end_token setting, mirroring the double-page rule. The "pages" metadata follows
+        the double-page schema (line boxes offset by the cumulative page widths).
+        self.provenance[set][sample] records the three source scan paths for the manifest.
+        """
+        dataset = self.preformat_read2016()
+        for set_name in ["train", "valid", "test"]:
+            for i, page in enumerate(dataset[set_name]):
+                dataset[set_name][i]["label"], dataset[set_name][i]["text_regions"], dataset[set_name][i]["nb_cols"], dataset[set_name][i]["side"] = \
+                    self.sort_text_regions(dataset[set_name][i]["text_regions"], dataset[set_name][i]["width"])
+        self.provenance = {"train": dict(), "valid": dict(), "test": dict()}
+        for set_name in ["train", "valid", "test"]:
+            pages_in_order = dataset[set_name]
+            n_triples = len(pages_in_order) // 3
+            for i in range(n_triples):
+                document = {"pages": pages_in_order[3 * i:3 * i + 3]}
+                new_img_name = "{}_{}.jpeg".format(set_name, i)
+                new_img_path = os.path.join(self.target_fold_path, set_name, new_img_name)
+                imgs = [np.array(Image.open(pg["img_path"])) for pg in document["pages"]]
+                max_h = max(im.shape[0] for im in imgs)
+                pad_bottom = list()
+                for k, im in enumerate(imgs):
+                    pad = max_h - im.shape[0]
+                    pad_bottom.append(int(pad))
+                    if pad > 0:
+                        fill = np.median(im.reshape(-1, im.shape[-1]) if im.ndim == 3 else im.reshape(-1, 1), axis=0)
+                        fill = fill.astype(im.dtype)
+                        band = np.ones((pad,) + im.shape[1:], dtype=im.dtype) * fill
+                        imgs[k] = np.concatenate([im, band], axis=0)
+                widths = [im.shape[1] for im in imgs]
+                offsets = [0, widths[0], widths[0] + widths[1]]
+                img = np.concatenate(imgs, axis=1)
+                img = self.resize(img, 300, self.dpi)
+                img = Image.fromarray(img)
+                img.save(new_img_path)
+                pages = list()
+                for page_id, page in enumerate(document["pages"]):
+                    page_label = {
+                        "text": page["label"],
+                        "paragraphs": list(),
+                        "nb_cols": page["nb_cols"]
+                    }
+                    for paragraph in page["text_regions"]:
+                        paragraph_label = {
+                            "label": paragraph["label"],
+                            "lines": list(),
+                            "mode": paragraph["mode"]
+                        }
+                        for line in paragraph["lines"]:
+                            paragraph_label["lines"].append({
+                                "text": line["label"],
+                                "top": line["coords"]["top"],
+                                "bottom": line["coords"]["bottom"],
+                                "left": line["coords"]["left"] + offsets[page_id],
+                                "right": line["coords"]["right"] + offsets[page_id],
+                            })
+                            paragraph_label["lines"][-1] = self.adjust_coord_ratio(paragraph_label["lines"][-1], self.dpi / 300)
+                        paragraph_label["top"] = min([line["top"] for line in paragraph_label["lines"]])
+                        paragraph_label["bottom"] = max([line["bottom"] for line in paragraph_label["lines"]])
+                        paragraph_label["left"] = min([line["left"] for line in paragraph_label["lines"]])
+                        paragraph_label["right"] = max([line["right"] for line in paragraph_label["lines"]])
+                        page_label["paragraphs"].append(paragraph_label)
+                    page_label["top"] = min([pg["top"] for pg in page_label["paragraphs"]])
+                    page_label["bottom"] = max([pg["bottom"] for pg in page_label["paragraphs"]])
+                    page_label["left"] = min([pg["left"] for pg in page_label["paragraphs"]])
+                    page_label["right"] = max([pg["right"] for pg in page_label["paragraphs"]])
+                    page_label["page_width"] = int(widths[page_id] * self.dpi / 300)
+                    page_label["side"] = page["side"]
+                    page_label["pad_bottom_px"] = pad_bottom[page_id]
+                    pages.append(page_label)
+
+                labels = [pg["label"] for pg in document["pages"]]
+                if self.sem_token:
+                    if self.end_token:
+                        document_label = "".join(self.tokens["page"] + lb + self.tokens["page"].upper() for lb in labels)
+                    else:
+                        document_label = "".join(self.tokens["page"] + lb for lb in labels)
+                else:
+                    document_label = "\n".join(labels)
+                self.gt[set_name][new_img_name] = {
+                    "text": document_label,
+                    "nb_cols": sum(pg["nb_cols"] for pg in document["pages"]),
+                    "pages": pages,
+                }
+                self.provenance[set_name][new_img_name] = [pg["img_path"] for pg in document["pages"]]
+                self.charset = self.charset.union(set(document_label))
+        self.add_tokens_in_charset()
+

         Add layout tokens to the charset

+        f.format()
+        counts = {s: len(f.gt[s]) for s in f.gt}
+        print("triple_page (consecutive scans, five-token scheme):", counts)
+        assert counts == {"train": 116, "valid": 16, "test": 16}, counts
+        with open(os.path.join(f.target_fold_path, "provenance.json"), "w") as fh:
+            json.dump({s: {k: [os.path.basename(os.path.realpath(p)) for p in v] for k, v in f.provenance[s].items()}
+                       for s in f.provenance}, fh, indent=1)
     if "paragraph" in a.levels:
         f = _LocalREAD("paragraph", a.temp, "READ_2016_paragraph_dan")
